meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: Claude 会按代码结构而不是文字来查找和改写代码，覆盖 25 种语言；能批量替换调用、导入等写法，并可在改写前先给你看预演结果。
howto.when: 当你要找或改写的是代码结构（形如 X 的函数、调用等，或做 codemod、跑 YAML 规则）而非字面文本时触发；查字符串、注释或文件名则改用 rg。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按语法结构搜索并列出匹配位置

say.text: 扫描这个仓库的 YAML 规则并报告违规
say.note: 运行 sgconfig 中配置的规则

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages: it finds calls, classes and imports shaped like X, runs codemods and YAML rules, and previews rewrites before applying them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is a code shape (calls, classes, imports shaped like X, a codemod or a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments or filenames it switches to rg.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter.
say_en.note: Searches structurally and lists each match.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x) and show a preview first.
say_en.note: Runs a dry run; no files change.

say_en.text: Scan this repo with our YAML rules and report violations.
